name: bag_of_holding_two_discards_are_two_triggers_one_for_each_card
notes: Printed: 'Whenever you discard a card, exile that card from your graveyard.' Each card discarded is its own trigger, even when one spell discards both. Seat 0 casts Mind Rot on itself and discards its two cards (both named Discard Card); the Bag has two triggers waiting on the stack. Seat 1 counters one of them with Tale's End ('Counter target activated ability, triggered ability, or legendary spell'): the other still resolves, so exactly one Discard Card is exiled and exactly one stays in the graveyard (graveyard: one Discard Card and Mind Rot; with a single trigger for both cards, countering it would leave both).
